Author: Sayuuryi
Name: Sawoo Plates
Description:
Adds a small menu bar to the Portrait Editor: copy and paste preset codes, a preset library with thumbnails and tags, finer camera, eye and head controls, and an alignment grid.

It also tells you when your gear no longer matches your portrait.
Punchline: A few extra tools for the Portrait Editor.
Changelog:
### Fixes
- A portrait image could fail to save when two saves of the same image overlapped
